result.description: Meta's text-based social network; the Threads API lets apps publish posts, read media and profiles, moderate replies, and get insights.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 authorization-code flow (threads.com/oauth/authorize, graph.threads.com/oauth/access_token). Short-lived tokens last 1 hour and can be exchanged for 60-day long-lived tokens, which can be refreshed. Scopes: threads_basic, threads_content_publish, threads_read_replies, threads_manage_replies, threads_manage_insights.
result.access_detail: Creating a Meta developer app is free and self-serve. Users with a Threads Tester role on the app can grant permissions right away, so dev and testing work with no review. Other users can connect only after each permission passes Meta App Review and the app is published. Advanced Access also needs Business Verification (from the permissions page; the Threads-specific review requirements were not fully verified).
result.api_notes: Graph-style REST on graph.threads.com. Covers single and carousel post publishing, media and profile retrieval, reply moderation, mentions, insights, webhooks, keyword search, oEmbed and web intents. A Postman collection is provided. Media for publishing must be hosted at a public URL.
result.blocker: Meta App Review (plus Business Verification for Advanced Access) is needed before arbitrary end users can connect. Tester-role users work without review.
